source.note: Monitoring-domain probes (NOT consumption). References are the DATA-PROVIDER benchmark codes, not 'whatever the models converged on'. Edible-offal monitoring matrix; base in pool. Species source facet (F27 provisional).

DATA-PROVIDER REFERENCE = A019K#F27.A00JB (Daniel). Drying CHANGES the nature of the raw commodity → use the processed derivative base 'Peppers, dried' (A019K), narrowed to chili via F27.A00JB. Raw chili pepper + F28 drying is INVALID. Wording: 'dried chili pepper(s)' = the dried-chili-pepper commodity; 'dried chili' alone is shorthand the benchmark reads the same way (not necessarily powder/flakes/dish).
